nodes.name: upload_to_drive
nodes.notes: Upload binary property 'data' to Drive. Destination name mirrors buildDriveName(codigo, timestampMs, ext): '<codigo>/receta-<timestampMs>.jpg' (timestamp produced inline via Date.now()). Parameter-level validation (operation/name/folderId/binaryPropertyName keys for typeVersion 2.1) happens on first import - open risk: adjust key names if the imported node flags them.
